title: Initial input-head boundary tag
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean input. In the initial configuration of $M$ on $x$, the input head is at position $1$ and its Boolean boundary tag is true: the tag is false at position $0$ and true at the right boundary position $|x|+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
